project.name: ai-job-outreach
project.objective: Specify a local approval-first cold-email outreach platform for matching AI roles to the user's resume, researching companies and verified professional contacts, generating evidence-grounded personalized drafts through Codex CLI, deduplicating outreach in Neon PostgreSQL, exporting jobs to CSV, and sending user-approved batches through Gmail.

assumptions.text: The resume attachment is not visible in the workspace. Implementation must accept a user-supplied PDF at runtime, extract professional links and sender details for confirmation, and ground every fit claim and metric in source evidence.

decisions.title: MVP operating model
decisions.text: The user manually invokes Codex CLI to discover, research, match, and draft outreach for at most 20 companies per run. There is no embedded LLM API and no automatic schedule in the MVP.

decisions.title: Approval and sending boundary
decisions.text: Every draft remains pending in the local dashboard until the user edits if desired and explicitly approves it. Neither Codex CLI nor ingestion may send email automatically. Approved messages are sent through Gmail.

decisions.title: Targeting and contact hierarchy
decisions.text: Target fresh AI-related roles worldwide, including remote roles, at seniority inferred from the resume. For onsite roles outside the user's location, require explicit relocation or visa support. Contact early-stage founders/co-founders, medium-company CTO or engineering leaders, and large-company best-fit HR/hiring or engineering leaders.

decisions.title: Verification and deduplication
decisions.text: Use public professional data and free service tiers only. Never send to an unverified address. Send at most one initial email per company; no follow-ups. Suppress the company for 90 days and allow it again only for a substantially different matching role. Replies and opt-outs override cooldown and suppress further outreach.

decisions.title: Storage and interface
decisions.text: Use Neon PostgreSQL as the system of record and provide CSV export. Provide a local-only web dashboard with no login. Store secrets only in .env and never expose them in source, logs, generated Markdown, or the database.

decisions.title: Storage and interface without CSV
decisions.text: Use Neon PostgreSQL as the sole system of record. The MVP has no CSV ingestion or export flow. Provide a local-only web dashboard with no login. Store secrets only in .env and never expose them in source, logs, generated Markdown, or the database.
